svg.title: LeAgents M0 — the collect→train→eval loop as code
svg.desc: A deterministic orchestrator cycles collect (8→16→32 episodes), train (lerobot-train, 300 steps), eval (lerobot-eval, success rate), and decide (state machine + SQLite); the loop ran 3 cycles in 22 minutes. An LLM proposer only suggests tasks and never controls the loop, and the decision cascade (promote, iterate, escalate, rollback) is a pure function of eval deltas. The M0 finding: a 0% plateau means under-training, not a policy ceiling — the escalate_floor guard iterates instead of escalating below a 5% baseline.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic','Noto Sans KR','Noto Sans CJK KR',sans-serif
